name: python-schema-evolution
title: Python schema evolution
blurb: Classify a JSON Schema change as breaking, risky or safe, and prove every breaking claim with a document that passed the old schema and fails the new one.
default_description: Classify a JSON Schema change: every breaking claim is proved with a real document that validated against the old schema and fails the new one, reader claims name the field that disappears, and a document from the old schema is never silently rejected.
next_steps: uv venv --allow-existing .venv && uv pip install --python .venv/bin/python -e . pytest ruff

verify.name: install
verify.cmd: uv venv --quiet --allow-existing .venv && uv pip install --quiet --python .venv/bin/python -e . pytest ruff
